description: Find Chrome Web Store extensions and themes by URL, keyword, category, top chart or curated collection, and export listings or public reviews.

categories.description: Store categories to browse (mode=`category`). Pick one or more; theme categories return themes.
categories.title: Categories

categoryUrls.description: Optional category page URLs for mode=`category`, e.g. https://chromewebstore.google.com/category/extensions/productivity/tools. Combine with `categories` or use alone.
categoryUrls.title: Category page URLs

collectionUrls.description: Curated store collection URLs (https://chromewebstore.google.com/collection/<id>) or bare collection IDs. Used when mode=`collection`.
collectionUrls.title: Collection URLs or IDs

developerNameContains.description: Keep items whose developer name contains this text (case-insensitive). Requires full details.
developerNameContains.title: Developer name contains

establishedPublishersOnly.description: Keep items from established publishers when the store marks them.
establishedPublishersOnly.title: Established publishers only

extensionUrls.description: Chrome Web Store detail or reviews URLs, or bare 32-character IDs. Used when mode=`urls` or mode=`reviews`.
extensionUrls.title: Extension URLs or IDs

featuredOnly.description: Keep items carrying the Chrome Web Store Featured badge.
featuredOnly.title: Featured only

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full detail page for each listing. Adds descriptions, publisher data, privacy disclosures and related extensions, but costs one extra request per item.
includeDetails.title: Include full details

language.description: Language of names, descriptions and store UI returned by the Chrome Web Store.
language.title: Store language

maxInstalls.description: Drop items with more installs than this.
maxInstalls.title: Maximum installs

maxItems.description: Maximum number of extension records (or review records in reviews mode) to save.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxRating.description: Drop items whose average rating is above this value (0–5).
maxRating.title: Maximum rating

maxReviewsPerExtension.description: Cap the number of reviews saved for each extension (mode=`reviews`).
maxReviewsPerExtension.title: Max reviews per extension

minInstalls.description: Drop items with fewer installs than this. The store publishes rounded install bands.
minInstalls.title: Minimum installs

minRating.description: Drop items whose average rating is below this value (0–5).
minRating.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied to extension and theme records. Leave them empty to keep everything.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

mode.description: What to collect. `urls` = look up specific items; `search` = keyword search; `category` = browse a category; `topCharts` = editorial charts; `collection` = a curated store collection; `reviews` = public user reviews.
mode.title: Mode

onlyRequestsAllUrls.description: Keep items whose manifest requests <all_urls> or *://*/* host access.
onlyRequestsAllUrls.title: Only broad host access

reviewsLanguage.description: Language of the review feed. Reviews are fetched in this language independently of the store `language`; `all` uses the store language.
reviewsLanguage.title: Review language

reviewsMaxRating.description: Keep only reviews with at most this many stars.
reviewsMaxRating.title: Maximum review rating

reviewsMinRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this many stars.
reviewsMinRating.title: Minimum review rating

reviewsSince.description: Keep reviews created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Reviews are paged in the selected sort order and filtered one by one; paging does not stop at the first older review. Invalid dates are ignored with a warning.
reviewsSince.title: Reviews since date

reviewsSort.description: Order in which reviews are read.
reviewsSort.title: Review sort order

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords to search for (mode=`search`). Each keyword is paginated until `maxItems` is reached.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

sortBy.description: How mode=`category` orders extension categories. Theme categories and search results keep the store's own order.
sortBy.title: Category sort order

topChart.description: Which editorial chart to read (mode=`topCharts`). Each chart has 25 items.
topChart.title: Top chart

verifiedOnly.description: Keep items whose developer has a verified business/trader profile (EU DSA trader disclosure).
verifiedOnly.title: Verified business publishers only

title: Chrome Web Store Extensions & Reviews Input
